properties.name: bahirledger.auth.web-origin
properties.description: Exact loopback browser CORS origin, or empty to disable cross-origin access.

properties.name: bahirledger.database.url
properties.description: Database JDBC URL; overridden by nonblank BAHIRLEDGER_DB_URL.

properties.name: bahirledger.database.username
properties.description: Database identity; overridden by nonblank BAHIRLEDGER_DB_USERNAME.

properties.name: bahirledger.database.password
properties.description: Database secret; overridden by nonblank BAHIRLEDGER_DB_PASSWORD.

properties.name: bahirledger.mail.mode
properties.description: Verification delivery: disabled, smtp, or exclusively-local file outbox.

properties.name: bahirledger.mail.verification-web-origin
properties.description: Configured public frontend origin for fragment-only email links; HTTPS except explicit local loopback.

properties.name: bahirledger.mail.smtp.port
properties.description: SMTP port; this adapter uses STARTTLS, not implicit TLS.

properties.name: bahirledger.mail.smtp.from
properties.description: Required explicit single sender email address for SMTP.

properties.name: bahirledger.mail.smtp.username
properties.description: SMTP AUTH identity; supply together with password or leave both empty for a trusted relay.

properties.name: bahirledger.mail.smtp.password
properties.description: SMTP AUTH secret; never log or place in command arguments.

properties.name: bahirledger.mail.smtp.starttls
properties.description: Require STARTTLS. False is permitted only for exclusively-local loopback SMTP.
